task.title: Read the Inspection Results from the Acme Console API
task.shortdesc: Developer guide. You send one request and get the readings of a work order as JSON. Fictional API, written for this portfolio.

ul.li: You have an API token with the scope readings:read.
You know the number of the work order.

step.cmd: Store your token in an environment variable, so it never appears in your code.
Send a request for the work order.
Read the readings list in the response. Each reading has a check, a value and a unit.

result.p: The response has the status 200, and the list has four readings. A status of 401 means the token is missing or out of date.

postreq.p: You can send 60 requests a minute with one token. A request over the limit gets the status 429, and you can try again after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.
